DuoAero 1.3.4 is an A-channel development update based on the original Duolingo 6.103.5 runtime. It is not a finished implementation of all requested features.

Lesson progress now accepts the dotted identifiers used by 75 of the 79 lessons. The first midterm's path is grouped by major topic, with a chest at the end of each topic and preserved identifiers for previous lessons and chest awards. The native section picker supports the single available midterm. Chest opening displays a 25-gem confirmation. Formula slots are closer to the equation, incorrect formula feedback uses the native mathematical renderer, and the isothermal pressure example uses an exponent. Word-gap blocks are placed inside their sentences.

Android emulator checks completed the first Atmosphere lesson with a wrong answer and native retry, claimed XP, then reopened its next lesson before and after a restart; earlier lessons were seeded. An S24-resolution emulator, word gaps, the section picker, formula selections, a chest with seeded prerequisites and matching-card examples were also tested. A sequence of completion-screen frames showed one moving Snoopy after removing a duplicate layer. These checks are not a physical Samsung test or a complete course traversal.

Still incomplete: one other celebration still shows Duo with Snoopy in its eyes and clips its statistics; emotion- and action-specific Snoopy artwork throughout the app, a complete content and large-text/night-mode audit, real Google/Drive sign-in and sync, updater download/install verification, physical sound and vibration, and the matching web interface. The latest Google emulator scenario timed out and was retried. Prior intermittent lesson-end responsiveness failures are not fully diagnosed.

`build-info.json` identifies the signing source and `SHA256SUMS.txt` identifies the signed APK. `build-1.3.4` is unsigned signing input and cannot be installed.
